scripts.dev: concurrently -k -n server,game 'npm run dev -w @panda/server' 'npm run dev -w @panda/game'
scripts.build: npm run build -w @panda/shared && npm run build -w @panda/server && npm run build -w @panda/game
scripts.typecheck: tsc --noEmit -p packages/shared && tsc --noEmit -p apps/server && tsc --noEmit -p apps/game && tsc --noEmit -p tsconfig.tools.json
scripts.format:check: prettier --write apps/game/src/main.ts apps/game/src/weapons.ts && git diff -- apps/game/src/main.ts apps/game/src/weapons.ts
